derived_from_batch01_failure_shape.observed_failure_shape: batch01 showed avoided-damage signal but the veto remained too broad and did not isolate the harmful pre-move subset tightly enough to clear strict scoring
derived_from_batch01_failure_shape.refinement_reason: batch02 narrows the veto to confirmed divergence instability so the mechanism targets fragile pre-move structures with stronger evidence instead of broadly filtering unstable-looking setups

hypothesis_label: Instability veto should improve only when divergence is explicitly confirmed before expansion

mechanism_contract.known_baseline_weakness: The primary baseline can approve apparent pre-move readiness without distinguishing confirmed divergence instability from merely noisy but still viable setups.
mechanism_contract.exact_mechanism_of_improvement: Introduce a confirmed-divergence veto state that blocks pre-move approvals only when deterministic instability and divergence evidence align before expansion, rather than applying a broad instability veto.
mechanism_contract.why_not_parameter_tuning: The refinement changes the veto definition to require confirmed divergence evidence; it is not a simple threshold-tightening of the batch01 instability filter.
mechanism_contract.why_expected_edge_should_survive_strict_: If real, the refinement should preserve only high-conviction fragility vetoes, improve avoided-damage concentration, and reduce over-veto behavior rather than exploiting a narrow parameter slice.

required_evidence_inputs: deterministic confirmed-divergence evidence that aligns with fragility before expansion
overlay/context suitability evidence from phase68i_dynamic_ladder_candidate only when used as optional secondary context
allowed_scope: confirmed divergence plus instability evidence before visible expansion
new selective fragility veto state before expansion
optional secondary compare against phase68i_dynamic_ladder_candidate for overlay/context suitability only
forbidden_scope: post-move exit management or runtime behavior changes
generic parameter-only tuning or random churn variants
